title: SQLite substituted with DETS (allowed embedded-DB equivalent)
evidence: src/books_store.erl:1-9 uses dets:open_file; README.md documents DETS in place of SQLite so no native driver is needed
suggestion: None — R7 permits a language-equivalent embedded DB; DETS is on-disk and satisfies the constraint

title: app.src declares registered process 'books_sup' that is never started
evidence: src/books.app.src:6 lists {registered, [books_sup]} but no books_sup module/process exists; books_app:start/2 spawns an anonymous linked process (src/books_app.erl:16)
suggestion: Drop books_sup from the registered list, or add the supervisor it implies

title: inets httpd started outside a supervision tree
evidence: src/books_app.erl:9-16 starts httpd and returns a bare spawn_link with no supervisor; an httpd crash would not be restarted
suggestion: Place httpd under a supervisor for OTP-idiomatic restart semantics; acceptable for a low-effort task

title: PUT performs a validated full replace of the book
evidence: src/books_http.erl:41-42 and src/books_store.erl:39-43 replace the stored map; README.md documents 'full replace' and same validation as create
suggestion: None — full-replace PUT is spec-consistent; documented in README
